title: Design System: Tide Table
scope: The app (web/, styles in web/src/styles.css) and the listening game (tools/listening_game.html). Shared tokens (the game names its region slots --patch-1 and --patch-2, same values as --region-a and --region-b), shared graticule and theme switch, shared theme choice in localStorage key es-theme.

numeral.purpose: Alignment number under each region's patch; weight 200 to 800 carries the value.

value.purpose: The live alignment readout in the now-playing row; weight follows alignment.

status.purpose: The one sentence about what is playing.

readout.purpose: Numbers, coordinates, axes, key caps; the only use of the mono face.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. No elevation shadows.

shadows.name: map-tag-ring
shadows.purpose: A solid outline (3px when active) so the region tag reads on any part of the picture. Not elevation.

shadows.name: current-underline
shadows.purpose: Marks the playing region's name in the rhythm rows.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Two 90 ms steps, no easing, for every state change. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.description: Outlined button for pause, stop, replay.

components.name: Tide Curves
components.description: Alignment over the model frames: one curve per region, labelled at its right end, signal line for the playing position, a gap where a frame is missing.

components.css: .ds-curves { display: block; overflow: visible; } .ds-curves .grid { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-curves .curve { fill: none; stroke: var(--region); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-curves .end { fill: var(--region); font: 700 14px 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-curves .now { stroke: var(--signal); stroke-width: 2; }

components.css: .ds-chart { position: relative; margin: 22px 0 0 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); height: 140px; } .ds-chart .well { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--well); } .ds-chart .tick { position: absolute; font: 400 0.75rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-chart .lat { left: -7px; right: -7px; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink) 7px, transparent 7px, transparent calc(100% - 7px), var(--ink) calc(100% - 7px)); } .ds-chart .lat b { position: absolute; right: calc(100% + 4px); top: -0.5em; font-weight: 400; } .ds-chart .lon { top: -7px; bottom: -7px; left: 50%; width: 1px; background: linear-gradient(var(--ink) 7px, transparent 7px, transparent calc(100% - 7px), var(--ink) calc(100% - 7px)); } .ds-chart .lon b { position: absolute; top: -18px; transform: translateX(-50%); font-weight: 400; }

narrative.northStar: The Tide Table on the Chart
narrative.overview:
Earth Sonata reads like a tide table printed on a sea chart. The NASA picture sits inside a chart frame with latitude and longitude ticks, and each region's numbers are set in ruled columns. Structure is 1px hairline rules, never boxes, cards or side stripes. Corners are 4px, nothing casts a shadow, and depth comes from rules, ink and the dark well behind the picture.

Two editions of one print. Light is almanac white with navy ink and tide-blue actions. Dark is the night edition: deep navy ground with the same inks lifted. The theme follows the saved choice, else the system setting, and is set before first paint. One red-orange, the signal, is the only loud colour and it means live, chosen or focused, nothing else.

The system is keyboard-first. Start is the first Tab stop, so the theme switch sits under the playback controls in the rail. Colour is never the only cue: every region mark carries its letter.
keyCharacteristics: One face, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono only for numbers, coordinates and readouts.
Signal red-orange is live, chosen or focused only.
Region A violet, Region B rose, both off the NASA picture's blue-to-red temperature scale, so a region colour is never read as warm or cold.
Hairline rules for structure; no boxes, no side stripes.
Type weight carries data: the giant numeral and the live value run weight 200 to 800 with alignment.
A missing frame breaks a tide curve and is never drawn as zero.

rules.name: The Live Only Rule
rules.body: Signal red-orange appears only on something live, chosen or focused. If it is decoration, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Off-Scale Rule
rules.body: Region colours stay violet and rose. Never blue, red, orange or yellow, because the NASA picture already uses that range for temperature.

rules.name: The Letter Rule
rules.body: A region colour never travels alone; its letter badge or end label goes with it.

rules.name: The Weight Is the Value Rule
rules.body: Alignment 0 maps to weight 200 and alignment 1 to 800, so the numeral's weight still carries alignment. Do not flatten it to one weight.

rules.name: The Numbers in Mono Rule
rules.body: Coordinates, table cells, axes and readouts use the mono face with tabular figures. Words never do.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A new surface gets a hairline rule or a neatline, not a shadow.

dos: Do use hairline rules (1px `rule`) to separate sections and table rows.
Do reserve signal for live, chosen and focused.
Do pair every region colour with its letter.
Do set coordinates, table cells and readouts in the mono face with tabular figures.
Do let font weight (200 to 800) carry alignment on the numeral and live value.
Do draw a missing frame as a break or hatched gap.
Do give both themes the same structure; only the inks lift.
Do keep Start the first Tab stop.
donts: Don't put content in boxes, cards or floating panels, or add side stripes.
Don't colour a region blue, red, orange or yellow.
Don't use signal for decoration, errors or missing data.
Don't draw a missing frame as zero.
Don't add a second text face or use the mono face for prose.
Don't let colour be the only cue for a region or a state.
